::: {.item}
### ECON 421. Quantitative Methods and Labs

Quantitative methods for evaluating public policy and social programs: implementation
quality, impact, and cost-benefit analysis.
:::

::: {.item}
### ECON 462. Economics of Human Capital

How human capital shapes economic growth and mobility, and the econometric techniques
used to study it.
:::

::: {.item}
### ECON 515. Labor Economics (graduate)

Labor markets and individual decision-making: wage determination, labor supply and
demand, human capital investment, unemployment, and the distribution of income. Theory
and empirical method, aimed at independent research.
:::
